statement: You are given a positive integer n.
Return how many digits n has when written in base 10.
Count them arithmetically: each integer division by 10 removes the last digit, so count the divisions until nothing is left.

examples.explanation: Dividing by 10 five times takes 74295 → 7429 → 742 → 74 → 7 → 0, so it has 5 digits.
A single division by 10 reaches 0, so 7 has 1 digit.
